questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ③: 나머지 보기는 모두 '형용사-부사' 관계이지만, ③ 'injure(부상을 입히다) - injury(부상)'은 '동사-명사' 관계이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어느 빈칸에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?

Please __________ the hot soup carefully.
You should __________ the school rules.
Be careful! The floor is __________ after the rain.
I __________ to be careful when I walk on the stairs.
Always use the __________ when you cross the street.
questions.explanation: ④: 차례대로 hold - follow - slippery - promise - crosswalk이 알맞다. happen은 '발생하다'라는 뜻으로 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 없다.

options: spill: to fall or flow out of a container
bump: to hit or knock against something
learn: to gain knowledge or skill in an activity or subject
questions.question: 다음 중 영영풀이가 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ①: 'land(착지하다)'의 영영풀이는 'to come down onto the ground from the air(공중에서 땅 위로 내려오다)'로 의도적인 착지나 도착을 의미하므로, ① '우연히 떨어지다'는 적절하지 않다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 연결된 것은?

• She will ⓐ___________ her camera tomorrow.
• She hopes ⓑ___________ Paris someday.
• You should ⓒ___________ unhealthy food.
questions.explanation: ③: ⓐ '~할 것이다', '~하겠다'라는 의미로 미래나 의지를 나타내는 조동사 will 뒤에는 동사원형이 이어지므로 bring이 알맞다. ⓑ 동사 hope은 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이므로 to visit이 알맞다. ⓒ 조동사 should의 부정형은 'should not+동사원형'으로 쓰므로 should 뒤에 not eat이 오는 것이 알맞다.

options: You will not bring your smartphone
You should not use your smartphone
You need to turn on your smartphone
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

G: David, be careful! It's a red light.
B: Oh, is it? Thanks for telling me.
G: ______________________________________ when you walk. It's dangerous.
B: Okay, I won't.
questions.explanation: ④: 다음 문장에서 '그것은 위험해'라고 했으므로, 빈칸에는 충고나 조언을 나타내는 You should not을 활용한 ④ '걸을 때 스마트폰을 사용하면 안 돼.'가 들어가는 것이 적절하다.

options: She will walk her dog on Saturday.
She will go to the gym on Monday.
She should clean the bathroom on Thursday.
She should take a Japanese class on Wednesday.
She won't visit her grandmother on the weekend.
questions.question:

Monday: go to the gym

questions.explanation: ②: 표의 정보에 의하면 오늘(today)이 화요일이므로 월요일은 과거의 일이다. 따라서 will go는 went로 고쳐야 한다.

G: Oh! Please tell me about it. (A)
B: Sure. When you see a fire, you should call 119 and shout "fire" loudly. (B)
G: Okay. (C)
B: You should cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth. (D) Then you should get outside quickly. (E)
G: I understand.
B: Also, you should use the stairs.
G: Okay. I'll remember those tips and be careful during a fire.

What should I do next?

questions.question:
Many students have fun at school. But sometimes, dangerous accidents happen. So we need (A)[to know / knowing] about common accidents. Let's learn!

Time
Many school accidents happen in PE classes (44%), at lunchtime (17%), or during break (10%).

Causes
Students get injuries when they (B)[played / play] soccer (19%), basketball (15%), or dodgeball (9%). Accidents also happen when students (C)[walking / are walking] (12%)!

Injuries
Students injure their fingers (23%), ankles (22%), and knees (6%).

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) need는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이므로 to know가 어법상 적절하다. (B) 주절의 시제가 현재시제(get)이므로 부사절의 시제도 현재시제로 일치시킨다. 따라서 play가 어법상 적절하다. (C) when이 이끄는 시간 부사절에서 주어 students에 대한 동사 자리여야 하므로, 현재진행형인 are walking이 알맞다.

(10:00 a.m., PE class)
(A) He injured his ankle!
(B) He jumped but landed the wrong way.
(C) Jinho played basketball.

(12:30 p.m., Lunchtime) Sora picked up a bowl of hot soup. Oops! She bumped into Jaemin! Sora spilled the hot soup on her arm.

(2:00 p.m., Break) Homin walked down the hallway. He looked at his smartphone. Be careful, Homin! Ouch! He bumped into the wall.

(3:10 p.m., After class) The school day ended. Minji wanted to go home ⓑquickly. She ran down the stairs and slipped!

We looked at some examples of accidents at school. Now write the safety promises below. You should keep ⓒthem!

My Safety Promises
ONE: I ⓓwill warm up before I play sports.
TWO: I will look around carefully when I was holding hot soup.
THREE: I ⓔwill use not my smartphone when I walk.
FOUR: I will not run on the stairs.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 알맞은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
